rows.vgi.doc_md:
## Products Reference

A built-in reference of the supported NOAA CO-OPS product mappings. Query sql_function, noaa_product and output_units to discover the right reader. This table is deterministic, requires no arguments and makes no network requests. Water heights also carry a datum; a unit alone is not enough to compare vertical references.

### Result columns

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| sql_function | Worker function to call. |
| noaa_product | NOAA product or metadata resource. |
| output_units | Primary measurement units returned by the worker. |
